description:
About Us

We, at Arcanna.AI, are dedicated to transforming the approach to cybersecurity with a unique blend of human expertise and state-of-the-art artificial intelligence technology. Our mission is to unlock greater human potential through the use of AI. At the core of this mission is our proud flagship product, an AI-powered cybersecurity solution that reduces the risk of human error and empowers human experts to make better decisions and take more informed actions.

Job Summary

We're looking for a junior team member with the potential to become an MVP software developer. Your primary role will revolve around the development of Arcanna.AI, our cybersecurity platform. You will have the chance to learn and work with experienced software engineers, researchers and subject matter experts, in a fast-paced environment with a diverse technology stack. This is a full time internship, we expect to extend the internship to a permanent position.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the development team to design and implement Python-based components for our cybersecurity platform.
  • Write clean, efficient, well-documented code to contribute to the overall functionality of the platform.
  • Contribute to the development of user interfaces using React and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with the front-end team to implement responsive and user-friendly features.
  • Work on containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes to enhance the scalability and reliability of our system.
  • Participate in daily meetings, sprint planning and retrospective meetings with your colleagues.

About You

  • Bachelor studies (ongoing or graduated) in Computer Science at a technical university - mandatory requirement.
  • Good knowledge of algorithms and programming principles.
  • Highly motivated to learn and grow as a professional.
  • Positive attitude towards work and assimilating new concepts.
  • Capable of analyzing problems and eagerness to solve them
  • Fluent in English
  • Python knowledge is a plus
  • React/Typescript knowledge is a plus

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package and benefits
  • Career growth opportunities in a product startup company
  • Flexible working arrangements and work-from-home options
  • Continuous development opportunities to enhance your skills
  • Private medical insurance
  • Work with a team of passionate and dedicated engineers and researchers
  • Become a part of our team and help us deliver an unparalleled level of cybersecurity that combines the best of human expertise and advanced AI technology. Join us in revolutionising the approach to cybersecurity and making the digital world a safer place.
